menu.deleteLast: Delete view (the last shared view stays)

delete.title: Delete view {{name}}?
delete.description: Only the view is deleted: the records stay in the table. Share links of this view stop working.

lock.locked: View {{name}} is locked: nobody can change its settings until it is unlocked.

unsaved.label: Unsaved changes
unsaved.hintLocked: This view is locked. Your changes are kept on this device only.
unsaved.hintReadOnly: You cannot change this view. Your changes are kept on this device only.
unsaved.hintSave: These changes are kept on this device until you save them.
unsaved.explainTitle: Your changes cannot be saved to this view
unsaved.explainLocked: This view is locked: its settings cannot change until it is unlocked. You can keep your changes as a personal view that only you see.
unsaved.explainReadOnly: You cannot change this shared view. You can keep your changes as a personal view that only you see.

gone: The view you were looking at was deleted or is no longer available to you.

dnd.instructions: Drag a view tab to reorder the views. With the keyboard, use Move left or Move right in the view options.

kanban.title: Kanban views are coming soon
kanban.description: This view will show the records as cards grouped by a field. Until then, open a grid view to work with the records.

form.title: Form views are coming soon
form.description: This view will be a form that adds records to the table. Until then, open a grid view to work with the records.

none.title: No view of this table is available to you
none.description: Your role does not show any shared view of this table. You can make a personal view: only you will see it.
